purpose: Pin a screened pool of source-derived MLSys/Coding tasks and an untouched-from-model train/development/held-out allocation.
primary_metric: held-out task success after policy update versus the same frozen initial policy without update
stop_reason: The current VARE separated-candidate path preserves frozen JSON function-task contracts. It does not yet safely run arbitrary repository patches against separate upstream pytest graders. No task rollout or model update is permitted until that narrow repo-task grading path is implemented and audited.
integrity_rules: Do not change split membership after any development rollout or training begins.
Do not expose grader files or source-patch references in agent-visible task prompts.
Do not run model or agent prompts against held-out tasks before final evaluation.
Do not call source-level regression replay an agent task rollout or capability result.
If fewer than 15 source-level candidates remain after independent grader/runtime qualification, expand the source pool and re-freeze before training.
